steps.en: Set up the pinned CUDA Python environment from the repo root
steps.zh: 在仓库根目录装好固定版本的 CUDA 环境

steps.en: Run the main script on a character image you may use
steps.zh: 对有权使用的角色图运行主脚本

steps.en: Download LayerDiff 3D and depth weights from Hugging Face
steps.zh: 从 Hugging Face 下载分层与深度权重

steps.en: Generate body, then head part layers with hidden regions painted
steps.zh: 先身体后头部生成部件图层并补画被遮挡区

steps.en: Predict depth per layer and stack layers far to near
steps.zh: 逐层预测深度并按远近排序

steps.en: Write a named-layer PSD plus a depth PSD
steps.zh: 写出带部件名的 PSD 和深度 PSD

value.en: A layered, depth-ordered PSD draft without hand-cutting parts or painting occluded areas
value.zh: 拿到按深度排好的分层 PSD 初稿，不用手工抠部件、补画遮挡区
